commands.label: read-claude-desktop-config
commands.note: Read claude_desktop_config.json and write to from_cli.json for light config build
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$cfg = Get-Content '%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $r=[PSCustomObject]@{cmd='cmd-read-cfg-001';label='read-claude-desktop-config';status='done';data=$cfg;ts=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ')}; $p='relay\from_cli.json'; $j=if(Test-Path $p){Get-Content $p -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}else{[PSCustomObject]@{results=@();updated=''}}; if(-not $j.results){$j|Add-Member -NotePropertyName results -NotePropertyValue @() -Force}; $j.results+=$r; $j.updated=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ'); $j|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20|Set-Content $p"
